 Date : 15-12-2023 This petition was called on for hearing today.
 CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.M. SUNDRESH  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHANSHU DHULIA  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Vivek K. Tankha, Sr. Adv.

 For Respondent(s)
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R

This is a very unfortunate case in which Criminal Miscellaneous Application No.9647/1984, State vs. Vidya Sagar and Ors. is kept pending after imposing a hold on the further proceedings in a case involving an offence punishable under Sections 302, 328, 201 and 498A of the IPC.

sentences.text: While granting interim protection from arrest in favour of the petitioner, we are inclined to call for a report from the Registrar General of the Allahabad High Court on the reason for the pendency of the Criminal Miscellaneous Application No.9647/1984 and the steps taken to either trace the file or its reconstruction.
Such a report has to be filed before this Court within a period of six weeks.
List the matter for further hearing in the 3rd week of February, 2024.
In the meantime, the petitioner is permitted to serve notice on the Standing Counsel for the respondent.
(KAVITA PAHUJA) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR) COURT MASTER (SH) COURT MASTER (NSH)

opennyai_summary.decision:
While granting interim protection from arrest in favour of the petitioner, we are inclined to call for a report from the Registrar General of the Allahabad High Court on the reason for the pendency of the Criminal Miscellaneous Application No.9647/1984 and the steps taken to either trace the file or its reconstruction.
Such a report has to be filed before this Court within a period of six weeks.
List the matter for further hearing in the 3rd week of February, 2024.
